stem:
The diagram shows Vivaan looking at a lamp flame through holes in three cardboard sheets X, Y and Z.

In which case can he see the flame?

options.text: The three holes lie on one straight line at the same height.
The hole in Y is moved well above the other two holes.
Light from the flame bends freely around the sheets, so hole alignment does not matter.
He makes the lamp brighter, so he can see through any arrangement of the holes.

teacher.key_rationale: Light travels in a straight line, so the flame is seen only when the holes are straight and aligned. Raising the middle hole, bending light, or brightening the lamp does not remove that need.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source ray diagram as three cardboard sheets X, Y, Z with aligned holes.
